title: Blind Man's Buff
tagline: Hunt by ear. Catch, then name who it is.
description: The party game of Colin-Maillard in a candlelit eighteenth-century room. Follow claps and giggles that appear as ripples, call out, catch a guest, then feel for clues and name them. Swap sides in Hide and Dodge. Four rooms, stereo sound, Watch and Learn, a full Rules page and text size up to 300%. Points only, no ads, works offline.
howToPlay: Tap the room to walk there; ripples show where sounds came from.
Press Call to clap: guests nearby answer, so you can map the room.
When a warm shape is within reach, press Reach to sweep your arms.
Feel the clues, pick the portrait of who you caught and confirm.
Name everyone before the sand runs out for up to three feathers.
Hide and Dodge: tiptoe is silent, steps and Tease are heard.
On a keyboard: arrows steer, Space reaches, C calls, F feels more.
